description: Every failed C call in lib/file.fz is {:error, :io} and every bang raises '... : I/O error' (reason_text/1). Elixir raises the errno reason: File.read!("nope") says 'could not read file "nope": no such file or directory', File.stream!("nope") |> Enum.to_list() says 'could not stream "nope": no such file or directory'. Add one runtime helper that reads errno after a failed call and returns Elixir's POSIX atom (:enoent, :eacces, :eisdir, :enotdir, :eexist, :enotempty, ...; see :file.format_error), return it as the {:error, reason}, and spell it in reason_text/1 with Elixir's text. Oracle fixtures for the common reasons on all three paths. Then bind fz-sc8.18's missing-file abort fixture to its elixir oracle (it carries fz's 'I/O error' text until then).
title: File's bang functions name the POSIX reason, as Elixir does
